boundaries: Anonymous production reads only; analytics, counters, mutations, avatar proxy and unverified APIs intercepted.
Resource file previews, nested links, rapid reversal and reduced-motion scenarios tested with isolated local fixtures. Production original resources expansion/collapse and lazy chunk were verified.
Auth/write flows and Service Worker install/update/offline behavior were not exercised. Static SW and app version hashes match the release.
Japanese and Korean docs retain the existing English fallback; native Catalan language review remains pending.
No background Worker was deployed or manually invoked; prior search-worker scheduling/sitemap acceptance is outside this UI release.

initialDeployment.resolution: Reproduced signed 0.9.9 immutable assets using its verified build version; retained all 220 paths, adding 93 files beside byte-identical 0.9.10 output. Redeployed and repeated acceptance.
